search_text: published ZDI-09-032 ZDI-CAN-441 Apple WebKit attr() Invalid Attribute Memory Corruption Vulnerability 2009-06-08 CVE-2009-1698 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-1698 ['Apple'] ['Safari'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple WebKit. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the handling of attr() functions in a CSS content object. When a large numerical value is passed as the argument to the attr() function, a memory corruption will occur which can be leveraged to execute arbitrary coder under the context of the current user. title: Apple WebKit attr() Invalid Attribute Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple WebKit. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the handling of attr() functions in a CSS content object. When a large numerical value is passed as the argument to the attr() function, a memory corruption will occur which can be leveraged to execute arbitrary coder under the context of the current user.
